name: Warrior
summary: Frontline combatant. Hits harder, takes punishment, closes fights decisively.

steps.text: +1 to all Attack rolls when Stamina is in Healthy range (boxes 1–5).
When Combat Fallout triggers, choose the Condition applied to you — it must be a standard Condition.
Once per encounter, reroll a Maneuver attack after paying the Stamina cost. Take the second result.
Once per round, one Combat Maneuver costs 0 Stamina. Declare before rolling. The effect still applies.
On a Boon (threshold 13–20 at Legendary), all Combat Maneuvers this round cost 0 Stamina.

design_note: Warrior gets stronger when fresh. Berserker inverts this — gets stronger when hurt. They are complementary, not redundant.

name: Defender
summary: Shield for the group. Absorbs damage and controls who gets targeted.

steps.text: +1 DR (stacks with armor). Interpose costs 0 Reactions once per round.
Broken threshold +1 — Stamina pool holds until box 16 before Broken.
Successful Interpose grants the protected ally Braced until end of round.
DR bonus increases to +2. Passive, always on.
Once per encounter, completely absorb one hit targeting any ally in Close range. No damage to either character.

design_note: Defender is outward-facing — protects others. Survivor is inward-facing — cannot be stopped. Both are defensive identities but mechanically and narratively distinct.

name: Ascetic
summary: Physical and spiritual perfection unified. Unarmed and unarmored by choice — the body is the instrument.
prerequisite_text: No prerequisite. Gains no benefit from wearing armor (and no penalty either).
suggested_aptitudes_text: Savage, Sentinel, Celebrant, or Shaman. See also Temple Trained (suggested new Background).

steps.text: Unarmed strikes use the higher of Strength or Agility as their Attack bonus — equivalent to a Standard weapon. Never treated as Improvised. Deflect uses the higher of Toughness or Agility.
Once per round, after any unarmed attack — hit or miss — make one additional unarmed strike as a free action against the same or an adjacent target. Declare after seeing the first result.

Once per encounter, when you would gain a Condition from a physical source, negate it entirely. Stamina damage still applies. Works against Stunned, Prone, Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Slowed, Restrained, Exposed. Does not work against supernatural or social Conditions.
Unarmed strikes ignore DR entirely. Passive, always on. Additionally, the Step 2 free strike can now target any creature in Close range.

Once per session, enter a state of perfect stillness for one full round. You cannot be targeted by any attack, Power, or effect. You take no actions. At the end of that round, your next attack ignores all active Conditions on the target and cannot be Deflected — only Defended against.

design_note: Step 5 stillness is not invisibility — attackers can see the Ascetic, they simply cannot reach them. The follow-up attack is the payoff. Once per session keeps it a signature moment, not a routine.

name: Scout
summary: Mobile awareness. Controls positioning and knows the terrain before anyone else.

steps.text: Disengage free once per round. +2 to all Observe rolls outside combat.
First attack each encounter from Hidden bypasses Defend — target may only Deflect.
Once per scene, move up to 2 range bands as a free action.
Once per scene, apply Hidden to yourself as a free action.
Your first attack each round is always treated as coming from Hidden — target may only Deflect. Passive, no declaration needed.

design_note: Scout is environmental positioning and reconnaissance. Skirmisher is combat tempo. Hunter is pursuit. All share the Agility/Acuity base but grow into genuinely different play patterns.

name: Speaker
identity: Social authority through Reputation and genuine leadership.
summary: Social authority through Reputation and genuine leadership.
prerequisite_text: No prerequisite. Typically pairs with high Morale and social Focus Skills.

steps.text: +2 to all social skill rolls when Reputation applies.
Lead used on Close range allies costs 0 Actions once per round.
Once per session, reroll any failed social skill roll after seeing the result.
The +2 bonus now applies to all social skill rolls unconditionally — not only when Reputation applies.
Reputation applies even when you are unknown: the +2 bonus fires on all social rolls regardless of context.

design_note: Speaker wins by being themselves more effectively. Infiltrator wins by not being themselves at all. Empath wins by knowing what the other person actually wants. Three social identities, three different methods.

name: Expert
summary: Problem solving through knowledge. Builds, deduces and adapts: the group's answer to problems no specialist can solve.

steps.text: +2 to Analyze and Observe when examining a scene, object or person. Given tools and one uninterrupted Task Block, repair any damaged item without a roll.
Once per scene, use any non-Focus Skill as a Focus Skill for one roll. Modify an item to grant a specific +1 bonus (GM approved) until it is used in combat; one active modification at a time.

Once per session, choose one: name a conclusion about a scene or person, and the GM says whether you are right (if wrong, one true thing that points to the answer); or create a single-use item that replicates a non-magical Skill effect.
Between sessions, make one modification permanent. Staged evidence, environmental misdirection and mundane forgeries do not fool you.

Once per session, choose one: reconstruct a past event you have evidence of in full; create an item one step beyond the Genre's technology ceiling; or name a Skill, and its Ability Score counts as 2 higher for the scene.

design_note: Expert replaces Artificer, Investigator and Polymath. The Archetypes show how to lean toward one of them.

name: Caster
summary: Arcane magic, learned or innate. Grows toward unrestricted power at lower cost.
prerequisite_text: Magic Overlay required. Cast skill 2+ required. Intellect 2+ or Belief 2+.

steps.text: Cantrips free (Cast 2+). Level Discount active on all Powers.
Maximum usable Power Level = Character Level + 1 (cap 5).
Surge cost on primary Cast school reduced by 1 box (minimum 1).
Once per scene, cast one Power at Level 1 or Level 2 for free — no Mana, no Surge cost.
Once per session, cast any Power at any Level for free. No Mana cost. Surge is not free — if Surged, those boxes are still paid.

design_note: A single framework covers Wizard, Sorcerer, and Warlock concepts. No spell slots — Mana pool plus Level Discount. The cantrip rule means dedicated casters never pay for baseline magical attacks.

name: Channeler
identity: Divine or spiritual healing and authority.
summary: Divine or spiritual healing and authority. Faith-sourced restoration and supernatural protection.
prerequisite_text: Magic Overlay required. Channel or Survive 2+ required.

steps.text: Spiritual Powers clear 2 Resolve (not 1). Level Discount active on all Powers.
Corruption points 1–2 clear per Full Rest with prayer. You gain Abjure: 2 Resolve; each earlier use this scene is −1 to the roll.
Spiritual Fallout duration reduced to 1 hour. No relational requirement. Abjure costs 1 Resolve.
Abjure costs 0 Resolve once per scene. Additionally, all Spiritual Powers automatically gain the Authority Over Supernatural bonus (+1 effective Power Level vs supernatural targets).
Once per session, nullify any supernatural effect targeting any ally within Near range. Declare after the effect’s success is determined, before consequences apply. No Mana, no Resolve, no roll.

design_note: No deity is required by the rules — Channeler describes the mechanical relationship, not the theology. A warrior-priest, a shamanic healer, and a faith-based field medic all qualify.

name: Medic
summary: Secular technical healing. Surgery, trauma care, and pharmacology — keeps the group functional without supernatural resources.
prerequisite_text: No prerequisite. No magic overlay required. Pairs with Toughness and Acuity.

steps.text: Your Tend action in combat automatically succeeds on one ally per round at no Action cost — you stabilize without rolling. Out of combat, Survive field triage DC is reduced by 4 (DC 8 instead of DC 12).
Once per scene, clear one ongoing Condition (Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Stunned, or Weakened 1 level) from any ally as a free action — no roll, no pool cost.
A successful Survive field triage check out of combat now clears the Injured condition (boxes 11–14). Normally this requires magical healing. Requires one uninterrupted Task Block.
Once per scene, in-combat triage unmars 2 Stamina boxes. Roll d20 + Toughness + Survive or Medic vs DC 12. On success: 2 boxes. On failure: 1 box. No pool cost to you.

Once per session, perform emergency intervention on any ally at any Stamina state including Broken. No roll required. The ally can act this round but is Weakened until a Full Rest. Additionally unmark all Hurt boxes (6–10) from their Stamina pool. Does not require a Full Rest.

design_note: Step 3 is the key unlock — mundane healing clearing Injured is normally impossible without magic. This makes the Medic Role essential in non-magical genres rather than a lesser Channeler. Step 5 parallels Channeler Step 5 in scope but uses no Mana or Belief — it runs entirely from skill and Toughness.
